title: Main code for a program
statement: Given a light program $P$, a procedure index $p_0$, and a Boolean flag $d$, the main code is the concatenation of the compiled main statement with the tail code, using the layout and instruction positions determined by $P$ and $d$.
caveat: The defining statement refers to auxiliary compiler constructions whose meanings are not supplied in the payload, so the informal description can only describe their compositional role.
